name: agentdomains
description: Claim and manage free domains (under makes.fyi or agentdomains.co) for the sites AI agents build, in one command.

interface.shortDescription: Free public domains for sites and APIs agents build
interface.longDescription: Give the agent a real public hostname under makes.fyi or agentdomains.co on demand: sign up, claim a name, set A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT/NS records, forward to an existing site, reverse-proxy over HTTPS, or tear it all down again.
defaultPrompt: Claim a free subdomain for the site you just built
Forward a free subdomain to my existing site
Point my domain at my server and enable HTTPS
